description_en: Queries the execution records of a task flow
description_zh: 调用ListTaskFlowInstance接口，获取任务流运行记录
name: ListTaskFlowInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to obtain the ID of the task flow
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en:
The mode in which the task flow is triggered. Valid values:

0: The task flow is automatically triggered based on periodic scheduling.
1: The task flow is manually triggered
parameters.help_zh:
触发类型，取值如下：
0：周期调度
1：手动运行
parameters.name: trigger_type

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query the execution records of the task flow. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-DD format
parameters.help_zh: 筛选出指定时间之后开始的任务流运行记录。时间格式为yyyy-MM-DD
parameters.name: start_time_begin

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query the execution records of the task flow. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-DD format
parameters.help_zh: 筛选出指定时间之前开始的任务流运行记录。时间格式为yyyy-MM-DD
parameters.name: start_time_end

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.name: page_index

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en:
Adjust filter conditions:

true: StartTimeBegin and StartTimeEnd are the time range for filtering services.

false: StartTimeBegin and StartTimeEnd are the time range for the task to run
parameters.help_zh:
调整筛选条件：  
true: StartTimeBegin和StartTimeEnd为筛选业务时间区间范围。   
false: StartTimeBegin和StartTimeEnd为任务运行时间区间范围
parameters.name: use_biz_date

parameters.help_en:
The running status of the task node. Valid values:

0: Waiting for scheduling

1: Running

2: Suspend

3: Failed to run

4: Run successfully

5: Completed
parameters.help_zh:
任务节点运行状态，取值如下：

1：正在运行
2：运行成功
3：运行失败
4：等待调度
parameters.name: status

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request fails

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request fails

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of execution records returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足条件运行记录总个数
